Otherwise known as  ''how to make Bars online (fast)''

This Strategy can be used to farm a lot of bars in the early game (World 1 and World 2), usually for building [[Construct#Statues|Statues]] or maxing [[Workshop]].<br>
It can also be used to farm gold for [[Drones#Drone_Points|Drone Points]] (you can skip Transmuter Bomb then, as Bars do not give any gold).

Before starting make sure your [[Bombs#tabber-Transmuter_Bomb|Transmuter Bomb]] is maxed in Workshop (requires '''Obelisk Level 18''', before that this Strategy is not nearly as efficient).
If it is not maxed yet, you can also use this Strategy to farm for the Workshop Upgrades before using it for Statues.
# Go to [[Options]], enable "Make Transmuter Bomb Do No Damage" and disable "Chain Bomb Ignores Floor Pauses"
# Put a bit of fuel into the [[Drones#Drone_Buffs|Chain Drone]]. (requires '''Obelisk Level 18''', if you do not have OB18, you can still do this strategy, just ignore everything regarding Chain Drone)
# Set the game to auto pause on Golden Rainbow Floor (''not'' normal Rainbow!) and put your phone down.
# Disable Autobomb (Autobomb does not stop on the auto pause)
# '''Check the game every few minutes while doing chores or stuff'''

Whenever you hit a Golden Rainbow Floor:
* Use one Transmuter Bomb and one Bomb of Plenty (bop).
* If the Bomb of Plenty does not destroy all ores on screen, use any method you like to clean up - more Bomb of Plenty, some other Bomb, manual clear with Pickaxe, does not matter.
This should net you a good amount of Bars (more than 30-60 mins of offline farm) per Golden Rainbow Floor, if you have the Transmuter Bomb maxed in Workshop.

=== FUEL in Chain Drone ===
Fuel costs 5 gems each, but makes you gain +50% golden floor multiplier, plus an additional 10% per Chain Drone Grade.
There are two strategies:

'''A)''' Put fuel into Chain Drone and leave it running whenever you need bars and/or are doing Grainbow Strat.
Benefits:
* Chain Drone increases in Grade, making future Bar farming easier. This is good preparation for gilding statues.
* You gain progress for Challenge 40
Disadvantage: 
* A slight Gem cost
'''B)''' Put only a small amount of Fuel into Chain Drone and only activate<ref>A drone suit is considered active if it is on on your screen, no matter if drones are currently paused or not. To disable a drone suit, go to Drone → Suits Menu and deselect it (or select a different suit instead).</ref> it after using the Transmuter Bomb on the Golden Rainbow Floor, but before throwing the Bomb of Plenty. Then disable chain drone directly after.
Benefit:
* Saves a few Gems
Disadvantages: 
* Lower Bar income in the long run, due to the lower Chain Drone Grade. This will most likely get annoying when gilding Statues.
* Stuck on Challenge 40

Strategy A) is the recommended one, at least until challenge 40 is done.
